title: Specify ingestion + iteration steps (05_ingest.feature new; 01_iteration steps red)
description:
Specs first, red before green; no production code in this task.

**Files:** `features/02_querying/05_ingest.feature` (new, @wip); `tests/steps/store_steps.rs` (red steps for both files); `src/spec/ch02_querying.rs` (embed).

**Specs:** 05_ingest — ingesting registered adapters fills the store (the ingest report counts); a session reported by two adapters lists once (first report wins, the chapter-1 rule); an ingested session round-trips losslessly (opening it from the store equals what the adapter returns, PartialEq); ingestion never writes the source (digest before/after, the importer-contract precedent); an empty registry is a clean no-op. Plus red step definitions for the existing `01_iteration.feature` scenarios (fixture adapters → store → ingest → iterate).

**Acceptance:** executable red (todo!()); @wip kept on both files.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
